title: Northbeam TechWorks Relief Granted on the Membership Ground
content:
A charge standing on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job may be relieved on the membership ground: the customer's Circle membership meets part of what the job has billed, and the amount it meets is booked on the job as a write-off naming that ground.

The relief is worked out only after the surcharge entry owed for the attendance it covers stands on the job's account. Until that entry stands on the job's account, the relief is not worked out.

## What the relief does to the job

The write-off lowers the service charges outstanding on the job by the amount relieved, so the customer is relieved of that much of the bill, while the original charge stays on file for the history. The entry names the ground the relief rests on and the line of work it was granted against.

## Granting the relief

The desk grants it with the agent-side tool `writeoff_service_charge_816a24da`, which is unlocked and then called by the agent; it is not among the ordinary desk tools and is reached only once unlocked. One call books one write-off entry on the job naming the ground it was granted on, dated the day it is granted and taken as a telephone entry.

## The five values the call carries

- `service_agreement_id` — an identifier: the reference number of the TechWorks work order or care agreement the relieved charge sits on, read from the work orders held on the customer's profile before the call.
- `customer_id` — an identifier: the reference number of the customer profile being relieved of the charge, read from that profile before the call.
- `work_order_line_reference` — an identifier: the reference number of the single line of work the write-off is granted against, read from the entries already booked on that job before the call.
- `waiver_amount` — the amount to write off, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed, always positive.
- `waiver_reason` — the ground the write-off is recorded on, exactly one of the following seven values.

| `waiver_reason` | When it is the ground recorded |
| --- | --- |
| `protection_plan_covered` | a ShieldCare plan authorises the work that was charged |
| `manufacturer_warranty` | the manufacturer's warranty covers that work |
| `membership_benefit` | a Circle membership benefit or its service credit meets the charge |
| `retailer_error` | the retailer's own mistake caused the charge |
| goodwill | the retailer chooses to relieve the charge for the inconvenience it caused |
| `contract_term` | a term of the customer's business contract requires the charge to be relieved |
| none | the entry records no ground at all |

## What the call returns

A one-line confirmation string naming the write-off entry reference that was created, the job it was booked on, the ground recorded, the amount written off in USD to two decimal places and the job's new outstanding service charges in USD to two decimal places. The presence of that entry reference in the reply is what shows the write-off was granted.

On success the job carries one more entry and a lower outstanding figure, and the customer can be told how much has come off the bill and on what ground.
